scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with exact-rational supplementary checks. Historical novelty is qualified by inaccessible older full texts. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: All positive observation masses and arbitrary distinct real nodes; exactly characterizes nonexpansivity but not the full norm for n>=5 or general four-node grids; uses unweighted first-difference variation, not squared-error risk.
title: A four-knot rigidity threshold for total-variation stability of convex least-squares regression
